status: BASE + 4G UPLINK (deferred boot), built from vendored source. NOT yet hardware-verified. GNSS, camera and SD still NOT present.
summary: Flash the ESP32-S3 router firmware directly from the browser. No command line or Python installation required.
upstream_license: NOT DECLARED - upstream repo has no LICENSE file and GitHub reports license=null. Only the vendored WireGuard submodule carries an explicit BSD-style licence. Redistribution terms must be clarified with the author before any product release.
base_note: Base plus an A7670E 4G uplink over UART (components/modem_4g) with a /modem web page to choose WiFi vs 4G. The 4G stack is started from its own task 2 s into boot, AFTER the SoftAP and web server are up, so a modem problem can never stop the AP coming up. RGB LED signalling is compiled in but DISABLED by default (the 0.2.0-4g.1 loop was traced to code running before AP start; the LED RMT allocation is the prime suspect). App console is UART0 so panics are visible on the CH343.
prereq_note: Recommended: Chrome, Edge or Opera. Close all other serial monitors first. Browser flashing writes bootloader, partition table, otadata and app.

verification.root_cause_4g_1: ROOT CAUSE FOUND for the 0.2.0-4g.1 no-AP loop and the 0.3.0-4g.2 connect/disconnect loop: main/uplink_manager.c called esp_event_handler_instance_register(base, id, NULL, uplink_esp_event_cb, NULL) -- handler and user-data pointer swapped. Both are pointers so it compiled silently, then tripped assert(event_handler) at esp-idf-5.5.4/components/esp_event/esp_event.c:787. In 0.2.0-4g.1 this ran before the SoftAP starts (esp32_nat_router.c:1633) so the device reset with no AP; in 0.3.0-4g.2 it ran 2 s later, so the AP came up and then dropped every cycle. The RGB LED was NOT involved.
verification.panic_backtrace_resolved: PASS - captured on UART0 and resolved with addr2line against nomadlink.elf: uplink_boot_task (esp32_nat_router.c:333) -> uplink_init (uplink_manager.c:261) -> esp_event_handler_instance_register (default_event_loop.c:38) -> ..._with (esp_event.c:856) -> esp_event_handler_register_with_internal (esp_event.c:787) assert.

toolchain: ESP-IDF 5.5.x (installed at ~/esp/esp-idf-5.5.4). The base does NOT build on IDF 6.x: main requires component 'json', which moved to the component manager.
stage_command: make stage-firmware  (rebuilds and re-stages the served payload; offsets verified against build_esp32s3/flash_args)

branding.firmware_artifact: nomadlink.bin (IDF project renamed from upstream's esp32_nat_router)
branding.note: The MQTT topic prefix stays esp32_nat_router: it is a functional broker identifier, not branding, and renaming it would break existing subscriptions.

reproducibility: NOT byte-reproducible, by upstream design: CMakeLists.txt force-rebuilds esp_app_desc.c so __DATE__/__TIME__ stay current. Two builds of identical source differ in ~67 bytes of the app descriptor only, same length. Do not treat a hash mismatch as a corrupt payload; the freshness guard is timestamp-based for this reason.
ui_present_in_base: /config (full config incl. uplink ssid/password, static IP, AP settings)
ui_still_to_build: A WiFi-vs-4G uplink selector - the base hard-assumes the STA is the only uplink, so this concept does not exist yet
rollback_note: 0.2.0-4g.1 bricked the AP (argument-order bug, now fixed). 0.3.0-4g.2 booted but looped on the same bug. 0.3.1-4g.3 carries the fix. 0.1.0-base.1 remains the last hardware-verified image (TEST-810).
